project.name: KHKD - Than Lan
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — than lan dut duoi va bam tran nha
project.story: The common house gecko (than lan in Vietnamese) lives in nearly every Vietnamese home. Two remarkable biological feats: (1) Tail autotomy — when grabbed, the gecko sheds its tail at a pre-formed fracture plane between vertebrae; the detached tail keeps wriggling for up to 30 minutes to distract the predator, and the gecko escapes. The new tail regrows with cartilage instead of bone, shorter and different color. (2) Wall and ceiling climbing — billions of tiny hair-like setae on the toe pads create molecular-level van der Waals adhesion, letting the gecko hang upside down from glass without any glue.
